name: Iterable SMS
description: Iterable SMS supports consented text-message delivery, templates, subscription controls, double opt-in, phone verification, and SMS history within an Iterable project.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated SMS-enabled project key and exact US/EU data-center enum. Relay pins 13 SMS-specific operations: four readiness reads run directly, one history read and eight consent/send/verification mutations require approval, and all consent-sensitive starts also require explicit recorded attestation.

credentialRequirements.name: ITERABLE_SMS_SERVER_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Iterable SMS server-side API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated server-side key for the exact SMS-enabled project.

credentialRequirements.name: ITERABLE_SMS_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Iterable SMS data center
credentialRequirements.helpText: Set to us for USDC or eu for EDC; Relay maps this enum to a fixed origin.

capabilities.label: Read SMS readiness
capabilities.description: Use four bounded SMS channel, message-type, and template reads.

capabilities.label: Read SMS history
capabilities.description: Use one bounded SMS-only sent-message read with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage SMS engagement
capabilities.description: Use eight consent, send/cancel, proof, and verification operations with approval.

allowed.label: Read Iterable SMS readiness
allowed.description: Read channels, message types, and SMS templates from the exact project and data center.

approvalRequired.label: Read Iterable SMS history
approvalRequired.description: Read a bounded SMS-only sent-message history.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Iterable SMS
approvalRequired.description: Update a consented phone/subscription, trigger double opt-in, send or cancel SMS/proofs, and verify phone numbers.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: API keys, JWTs, verification codes in results, authorization headers, and secrets never enter agent-visible credential fields or logs.

blocked.label: Act without consent attestation
blocked.description: Phone collection, subscription changes, double opt-in, SMS/proof sends, and verification starts require explicit recorded consent attestation.

blocked.label: Use broader Iterable APIs
blocked.description: Non-SMS templates/messages, campaigns, exports, bulk operations, arbitrary paths/origins/headers, and destructive administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Provision SMS infrastructure
blocked.description: SMS providers, senders, channels, message types, verification profiles, carrier registration, and compliance settings require provider-side setup outside Relay.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four readiness reads run directly; SMS history and all eight consent/send/verification mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 13 selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; consent attestation, fixed SMS routes/filters, bounds, audits, and secret/provider-setup blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts SMS-only Iterable tools, injects the encrypted project key, and maps the stored region enum to a fixed origin.
Railway mounts SMS-only Iterable tools, injects the encrypted project key, and maps the stored region enum to a fixed origin.

providerSetup.blocker: Iterable SMS requires provider-side service, sender, channel/message-type, carrier/compliance, and optional verification-profile setup plus a customer-owned key. No console, account, credential, consent, SMS, verification, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Complete Iterable SMS and carrier setup outside this worker, configure a dedicated staging key plus us/eu region in Railway staging, and verify channel/template binding, approval and consent-attestation denial/allow, SMS/proof send and cancellation, double opt-in, phone verification, opt-out enforcement, bounds, rate limits, key revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Iterable documents SMS provider/sender/channel/message-type setup, exact phoneNumber profile use, opt-out instructions, consent, and double-opt-in requirements.
Iterable documents server-only verification begin/check calls, add-on/provider setup, and the distinction between phone verification and SMS marketing consent.
The live Swagger spec publishes the selected SMS target/cancel, SMS template/proof, user/subscription, double-opt-in, verification, channel, and message-type routes.
Iterable requires written express consent before mobile messaging and requires compliant opt-out handling.
